summary: Frontend-only Legacy redesign verification completed on public URL. Legacy chapter opens from circuit marker, full-screen layout remains stable across requested viewports, dynamic stats/heading/content render correctly, theme accents switch correctly for Ferrari/Mercedes/McLaren, reduced-motion view remains visible, and Back to Circuit returns to progress-aware circuit overview. One critical regression found: timeline marker selection from circuit map is unstable and can open wrong chapters.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking timeline marker does not reliably open timeline; observed misroutes to moment/tracks/transit in repeated attempts.

integration_issues.issue: Marker-to-chapter routing is flaky for timeline marker after returning to circuit overview; first full test run also routed to milestones unexpectedly.

action_items: Fix timeline marker hit reliability in Silverstone map so marker click always resolves to intended chapter.
Validate marker hit areas/z-order/transform behavior under circuit overview state and after Back to Circuit transitions.
Re-run marker stability test (>=5 consecutive attempts per marker) for timeline and neighboring markers after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy chapter CSS and content implementation matches requested redesign scope and preserves viewport stability across tested sizes.
Dynamic stat values and key informational/testable elements are correctly wired with data-testid attributes.
Chapter marker interaction reliability remains a critical UX/navigation risk; selector-level click on timeline marker is not deterministic in repeated runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use real user flow (go to circuit overview -> click markers) rather than direct hash-only checks. Legacy itself passed at 1920x800, 1366x768, 1366x640, 390x844, and 390x844 reduced-motion with no horizontal overflow and correct values: 7/105/202/104/31/19. Back to Circuit returned to circuit with progress-aware label including CURRENT POSITION / LEGACY. Menu-based navigation to Timeline/Cars works. Marker stability probe (5 attempts) for timeline marker produced mixed data-active values: ['timeline', 'moment', 'moment', 'tracks', 'transit'].
rca of the issue: Reproduction: from circuit overview, click timeline marker repeatedly after immediate route settle; active chapter intermittently resolves to non-timeline chapters. Likely root cause is marker interaction ambiguity in SVG map layer (hit targeting/z-order/transform timing around animated map state), not Legacy content rendering itself. Mitigation: tighten marker hit-target ownership and deterministic event target handling per marker, then retest repeated clicks across all nearby markers.
